fusions.name: Winding Sheet
fusions.desc: Wraps an enemy up to 5 tiles away that is at or below 25% health, which deals 20 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Smothering Fold
fusions.desc: Throws a fold of padding over a cone 2.5 tiles ahead, which deals 3 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Damped], its damage lowered, for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Dressing Station
fusions.desc: Binds the wounds of the ally who needs it most, restoring 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Self-Binding Wraps
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health wraps you for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
